snapshot.description: Tester feedback: players don't know what buttons do. Need plain-language tooltip copy for 3 screens: (1) Mining screen — deploy drone, boost, recall, etc, (2) Mission debrief — each action button, (3) Launchpad — launch, fuel indicator, target selector. One sentence per button. Friendly, not technical. This directly unblocks ticket ifkjpb which the agent can then implement. ~1h.
